ValidationRule.description: SCRUM-445: Closing as Closed Won is blocked while the discount is above 15 % and no approval covers it (no approval, Pending, Rejected, or raised above the approved value). Lowering keeps the approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), Discount_in_Pct__c > 15, OR(ISBLANK(Approved_Discount_Value__c), ISPICKVAL(Discount_Approval__c, "Pending"), ISPICKVAL(Discount_Approval__c, "Rejected"), Discount_in_Pct__c > Approved_Discount_Value__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Chance cannot be closed as Won: the discount is above 15 % and no approval by the direct manager covers it (waiting, rejected, or raised above the approved value).
